attempt1: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: twin-petal lantern column with a long teal channel and a left greeting arm
- silhouette: tall slender column with a subtly flared stable base
- crown: restrained split-petal crown with smooth finished edges
- opening: one long narrow recessed channel
- pose: one curved LEFT arm raised in greeting, ending in one seamless oval tip; the other curved arm stays close to the body
- expression: serene
- exterior material: soft cool-neutral off-white porcelain, never pure digital white
- characteristic color: deep ceramic teal, precisely one hue family matching #146B68
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- body height at least 2.4 times visible face height; elegant adult collectible proportion, never chibi
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional opening: the long narrow teal channel; no other body openings except the seed mark
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, teal iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy

- one compact Palari seed mark on the lower body: exactly six circular apertures arranged as four larger circles at the corners of a compact rectangle plus two smaller circles centered vertically between the corner pairs
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.

Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; square composition, full figure visible, centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height with generous clear space around crown, arms, and continuous base.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, or realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, or shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, or demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, or neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, or appliance details, random holes or more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, or antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, or household appliances, generic mascot smiles, mouth, chibi proportions, horror, or vacant doll eyes, text, labels, numbers, logos, or watermarks, extra characters, props, pedestal, cropped body, duplicated arms or eyes.
